results.title: The chat panel
results.checks: The host starts a session; the bar gains Chat, which opens the old reader's chat panel listing Session chat and Study companion. A guest joins: the host's chat says 'Flow guest joined'. The guest types @ and picks the host from the list, adds 'see John 3:16': the host sees 'Flow guest is typing...', then the line with their @name marked and John 3:16 as a link, which opens John 3 with verse 16 chosen. With the chat closed, '@everyone hello' puts @ on the host's Chat button; opening the chat clears it
results.note: Chat listed Session chat and Study companion; the join, typing, the @mention, the John 3:16 link and the @ badge all worked

results.title: Show everyone, the roster, chat, the record
results.checks: Host starts a session (a record is kept in the Library; its path on hover); a guest joins; the guest selects 3:16 and the host's roster says so; the host shows everyone 3:9 and the guest sees the ribbon; a chat line from the guest reaches the host
results.note: record kept; roster shows the guest at verse 16; the guest saw verse 9 shown; chat reached the host (code YYGRN2)
